doe-osti-3683725-verification-and-valida: Wind and water turbines spin inside tight spaces — and the walls change the flow. This work checks flow confinement modeling using OpenFAST's source panel method, verifying the math against reality. doe-osti-3874827-relaxing-topological-co: Engineers divide curved surfaces into neat four-sided grids — and refining those grids hits snags. Fischer and Shaw loosen the topological rules for refining conformal quad meshes, letting the mesh adapt more freely. The payoff is smoother, more accurate simulations of complex shapes.
